title: Log MMP Constraints on Curves with Cuspidal Singularities
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth projective surface and let $C\subset X$ be a unicuspidal rational curve with one Puiseux pair $(p,q)$. We use the log minimal model program to prove a sharp upper bound on the self-intersection of $C$ conjectured by Weimin Chen in [C, Conjecture 1.15] in the course of his study of contact structures and their symplectic fillings. We then extend this argument to rational curves with arbitrary cuspidal singularities and compare the resulting algebraic bounds with the symplectic bounds of Golla and Starkston [GS].
